race.description: Ladbrokes Flex Your Multi Stays Alive Mdn Plate
race.comment: Newcomers hold the key here. MEDIA DARLING (7) is a well bred filly by Snitzel out of G1 winner Media Sensation who kicks off for the Moody & Coleman yard. Plenty of jumpout experience has her ready to go first time out and she should take beating on her home deck. PLEASE PLEASE ME (9) is a filly by Stay Inside on debut for the Begg yard. She's jumped out well and the stable are always hard to beat with their fillies. ASSUNTA (1) is a Pinatubo filly on debut for the Price & Kent Jnr yard who has won a jumpout for a yard who are also very hard to beat at home. NYAD (8) is a filly by Deep Field for the Littlefield stable who looks smart and can measure up. AMBER QUEEN (13) was pick of the raced ones off a sound debut.
